gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare as shown coloured yellow on Drawing No. CM 128, commencing from the grade-separated interchange at the junction of Wong Chuk Hang Road near Aberdeen Technical School, running in a south-easterly direction for approximately 280 metres, then turning to a south-westerly direction over the Aberdeen Harbour and then on Ap Lei Chau for about 870 metres, then turning in a north-westerly direction for about 450 metres and terminating in front of the Ap Lei Chau public housing estate.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此道路位置在 CM128 號圖則上以黃色標明，起自接近香港仔工業學校接連黃竹坑之分層交匯處，向東南伸展約二百八十米，再向西南橫跨香港仔灣，續在鴨脷洲上伸展約八百七十米，再向西北伸展約四百五十米，至鴨脷洲公共屋邨前終止。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Cul-de-sac as shown coloured red on Drawing No. CM 128, commencing at its junction with Ap Lei Chau Bridge Road, running in a north-westerly direction for approximately 300 metres.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此盡頭路位置在 CM128 號圖則上以紅色標明，起點接連鴨脷洲橋道，向西北伸展約三百米。
